verses.english: A psalm of David, after he battled Goliath.

verses.hebrew: צָעִ֗יר הָ֭יִֽיתִי בְת֣וֹךְ אָחָ֑י;  וְ֝נַ֗עַר בְּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.english: Young I was in the midst of my brothers, and a lad in my father’s house.

verses.hebrew: רֺ֭עֶֽה בְּצֺ֣אן אָבִ֑י; נוֹהֵ֖ג עֶדְר֥וֹ בַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.english: A shepherd of my father’s flock, driving his herd in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: יָדַ֗י עָ֭שֽׂוּ עוּגָ֑ב; אֶ֝צְבְּעוֹתַ֗י כּ֥וֹנֲנוּ נָֽבֶל׃
verses.english: My hands performed upon a lute, my fingers worked a lyre.

verses.hebrew: וּמִ֣י יַגּׅ֣יד לַיהו֑ה;	י֝הו֗ה ה֥וּא יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.english: And who can tell Adonai? Adonai – He will hear.

verses.hebrew: ה֭וּא שָׁלַ֥ח מַלְאָכ֑וֹ; וַ֫יִּקָּחֵ֥נִי מֵאַ֣חֲרֵי צֹא֣ן אָבִֽי׃
verses.english: He sent His messenger, and took me from after my father’s flock.

verses.hebrew: וַ֭יִּמְשָׁחַֽנִי בְּשֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחָת֑וֹ; וַיְּצַוַּ֖נִי נָגִ֣יד עַל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.english: And He anointed me with anointing oil, and appointed me a prince of my people.

verses.hebrew: אַחַ֗י טוֹבִ֣ים וּגְדוֹלִ֑ים; וְלֺ֥א בָ֝הֶ֗ם  חָפֵ֥ץ יהוֽה׃
verses.english: My brothers are good and strong, but them Adonai did not desire.
He took me out towards the Philistine, who cursed me through his idols.

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִ֤י ׀ שָׁלַ֗פְתִּי חַרְבּ֥וֺ; וָאֶכְרֺ֣ת רֹאשׁ֣וֹ מֵעָלָ֑יו; וָאָסִ֥יר חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.english: And I tore off his sword, and cut off his head, and removed reproach from the children of Israel.
